model: Educational averaged behavioral equivalent; NOT the manufacturer LT3652 macromodel.

cases.name: Charge, taper, and finish
cases.description: Bright sunlight: charge at 500 mA, approach 4.2 V, taper below the green-LED threshold, then reach timer termination.
events: First timer cycle retries if the cell is not near full
Green off during taper does not mean charging has ended
Second timer cycle can terminate charging

cases.name: Hot / cold fault and recovery
cases.description: 55 C and -10 C sensor conditions pause charging and light both LEDs. Returning to 25 C resumes charging.

cases.name: Clouds, night, and sunrise
cases.description: Partial cloud reduces available charging current. Very weak light can stop charging while the battery is not full. Night turns the solar-powered LEDs off.

cases.name: Bad-battery timeout
cases.description: Fault-injection fixture: the cell voltage does not rise despite preconditioning current. After about 22.4 minutes the red LED turns on and charging stops.
events: Fault injection: battery cannot recover voltage

cases.name: Recover a low-voltage model cell
cases.description: An approximately 2.85 V model cell starts at 75 mA preconditioning, rises above the threshold, and moves to 500 mA charging. This is not permission to recover a damaged real cell.
events: Normal charging after model voltage recovers

cases.name: Full battery, load, and recharge
cases.description: After timer termination a 150 mA external load discharges the cell. Below the recharge threshold the charger restarts. An external load can affect charging and termination.
events: Timer termination expected near this time

cases.name: Disconnected temperature sensor
cases.description: Opening the NTC disables temperature monitoring; it does not produce an open-sensor alarm. Reconnecting it at 55 C produces the temperature fault.
